snippet_primary: "Where Gumroad treats courses like glorified file downloads, Podia includes a proper course builder with drip content, quizzes, completion tracking, and a clean learning experience for your students. You also get a full website and blog builder on your own custom domain, so Podia can replace both your course host and your basic website. That's a level of integration Gumroad simply doesn't offer."
subject_exact: Comparación de Bootstrapping Ecommerce: Gumroad trata los cursos como 'glorified file downloads' mientras Podia incluye course builder con drip content, quizzes, tracking de completitud, y website/blog builder con dominio propio — nivel de integración que Gumroad no ofrece
